Include tests/cmake/K12.cmake and call server1_register_k12_tests(), which registers K12-01/02/03-enginefs-lifecycle with labels server1;native;K12 and its own Qt PATH rule. Expected inventory 68 -> 71. Optionally add server1_k12_lifecycle to server1_spine_contracts_link_test.
Record K12-A as integrated only after B-W3F acceptance.

link_dependencies: server1_k12_lifecycle links server1_k00_policy (Value, JsConversions) and server1_k11_engine (EngineRegistry for RegistryEngineCatalog, EngineTimer).

authored_headers: include/server1/policy/EngineLifecycle.h (EngineLifecycleContract: EngineCounter, EngineLifecycle, EngineCatalog, RegistryEngineCatalog, LifecycleEngine, EngineStatsSnapshot, serializeEngineStatistics, serializeAllEngineStatistics, jsNumberToString, jsJsonStringify)
interface_changes.note: New headers only, following the K11 precedent of an authored policy header outside owned_files. No accepted predecessor header, frozen port, K11 source, aggregate file or STATE is changed.

composition_seam_requests.why: K12 is complete against controlled engines and the real EngineRegistry. Connecting it to live TorrentEngine instances for H01/C00 needs engine data that TorrentEngine does not expose. These are requests to the K11 owner through INT-W3, not changes made here; no field is filled with zero.
lifecycle_engine_surface: torrent view once metadata is installed: pieceLength, verificationLen or realPieceLength, files with offset and length
havePiece(piece): the committed-piece bitfield (committed-only, as K10-H/K11 require)
a piece-committed notification per piece (the source's engine 'verify' event), delivered on the app lane
buffer(): whether the engine runs the circular store (e.buffer)
storeDest(fileIndex): the persistent store's destination path (e.store.getDest)
select(from, to): an engine-owned whole-file background selection with priority false

available_today: files (TorrentEngine::files(), serialized as {path,name,length,offset} plus __cacheEvents from EngineLifecycle::cacheEventsEmitted)
sources and peerSearchRunning (peerSearchStats, peerSearchRunning; lastStarted must become an ISO-8601 Date string and be absent before the first run)
missing: per-wire records: peerChoking, outstanding request count, peerAddress, amInterested, isSeeder, download and upload speed
pieceLength and the committed bitfield for per-file streamProgress

composition_seam_requests.swarm_pause: M564 wires engine-idle to EngineFS.settings(hash, {swarm: 'PAUSE'}). TorrentEngine has no public pause; K10-G provides pause at the transport.
composition_seam_requests.creation_order: EngineRegistry::list() iterates a std::map (sorted). The composer must forward every EngineEvent to RegistryEngineCatalog::observe(), or K11 may return creation order.

observations_outside_k12: K00 jsonStringify formats numbers with setprecision(17) (0.1 -> 0.10000000000000001), which is not JSON.stringify. K12 uses its own jsJsonStringify and does not change K00.
EngineRegistry::remove erases the entry immediately, so a second removal during a pending destroy is a no-op; the source destroys twice and emits engine-destroyed twice (SOURCE-TRACE ledger item 9).
gate: Producer-ready candidate. No integration, B-W3F formation or acceptance, and no H01 work is claimed.
